narratives.Overview:
1. Add explicit merge as a declarable requirement on requires / requiredEvidenceKind / acceptanceAxis without placing merge inside STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES. Suitability dual: a declared merge requirement accepts kind: merge; kind: merge is suitable only when merge is explicitly declared — empty-axis / undeclared must refuse kind: merge.
2. Add a merge-kind stamp sibling that stamps only criteria that explicitly declare merge, with a pointer verified as an ancestor of the refreshed delivery tip (verifyDeliveryAncestry shape). Give that sibling a production caller on the persist/bind → complete / acceptance stamp path (and/or scope:stamp-evidence). Inventory stampMatchAnyFileEvidence / scope:stamp-evidence as the live #4840 writer; say what happens to unused stampDeclaredTestEvidence (#4732) — wire both or retire/document the orphan helper.
3. Empty-axis over-accept: criteria that are inferred-only or undeclared stay unattested; the run fails visibly naming each one. Do not auto-stamp merge from keywords or empty-axis alone.
4. Stamp-time kind-versus-pointer coherence for human and agent stamps alike, extending uatPointerShapeError (e.g. kind: test cannot point at a non-test artifact). recorded_by remains non-authoritative control.
5. skipAcceptanceEvidenceGate stays without a production caller. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry.
6. Non-goals: #3791 post-merge lifecycle move; #3781 pre-merge attestable; #3041 delivery-evidence requirement change. Do not entangle DeliveryEvidence ancestry rewrite with acceptance kind: merge stamps.

Round 1 critic. Fresh seat. Charter refutation. Id ceiling 5873233762. Dispatch SHA df69642fb0dd6496d333393f84a9500a917ab446 (git rev-parse HEAD matched; pin reads via git show).

Refutation target under test: Without an explicit merge declaration and a merge-kind stamp sibling with a production caller, finalizeCohort / acceptance evidence cannot honestly stamp only criteria a merge establishes, and keyword inference / isEvidenceKindSuitable still over-accepts or mis-stamps criteria.

## Verdict on the target

The refutation target survives. At this SHA, criteria still cannot positively declare `merge` on `requires` / `requiredEvidenceKind` / `acceptanceAxis`; no merge-kind stamp sibling exists; `stampDeclaredTestEvidence` still has no production caller; empty-axis suitability still accepts any evidence kind including `merge`; pointer-shape coherence at parse time still exists only for `uat`.

## Merge declaration must stay outside STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `git show df69642fb0dd6496d333393f84a9500a917ab446:packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts` — `STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES` is defined as axes merge/review alone cannot satisfy (`deploy|smoke|uat|observed_behavior`). `inferRequiredStrictAxes` admits explicit `requires` / `requiredEvidenceKind` / `acceptanceAxis` only when the value is in that set, so `requires: "merge"` is ignored and falls through. Re-ran the extracted suitability rules: `{requires:"merge"}` yields `[]` and `isEvidenceKindSuitable("merge", []) === true`. When any strict axis is present, `isEvidenceKindSuitable` returns false for `kind === "merge" | "review"` before axis equality.
Failure mode: Binding "add merge to the fields that today accept only STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES" by placing `merge` inside `STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES` makes a merge-declared criterion reject `kind: merge` evidence, so the stamp sibling cannot satisfy the gate it was built for.
Disposition: Bound lean must widen the declaration vocabulary without folding `merge` into `STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES`, or must recut suitability so a declared merge requirement accepts `kind: merge`.

## Production stamp inventory is stampMatchAnyFileEvidence, not stampDeclaredTestEvidence
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `git grep stampDeclaredTestEvidence` at the pin shows the symbol only in `acceptance-evidence.ts` (definition) and `acceptance-evidence.test.ts`. Production verb `scope:stamp-evidence` (`packages/core/src/scope/stamp-evidence.ts`) calls `stampMatchAnyFileEvidence`, which also stamps `kind: "test"` and skips when `inferRequiredStrictAxes(...).length > 0`. No merge-kind writer exists beside either helper.
Failure mode: Binding a "sibling to stampDeclaredTestEvidence" plus "give both writers a production caller" without naming the live #4840 path leaves the merge stamp orphaned the same way #4732 is, while `scope:stamp-evidence` keeps auto-writing `kind: test` on empty-axis clause rows.
Disposition: Inventory `stampMatchAnyFileEvidence` / `scope:stamp-evidence` before inventing a third writer; put the merge sibling's production caller on the persist/bind → complete walk (and/or that verb), and say what happens to the unused #4732 helper.

## finalizeCohort owns delivery evidence; acceptance kind stamps are on the complete gate
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `finalize-cohort.ts` imports `completeCohort` and `delivery-evidence` helpers; pin grep finds no `acceptance-evidence` / `stampDeclared*` / `stampNamespaced*` / `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` import in finalize itself. `complete-cohort.ts` dry-runs `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems` then `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` on a clone and does not stamp `x-directive/evidence`. `transition.ts` on `complete` persists clause-keyed items then evaluates the gate; `skipAcceptanceEvidenceGate` is documented test-only and has no non-test production assignment at this SHA.
Failure mode: Binding prose that treats finalizeCohort as the place that currently keyword-stamps or mis-stamps merge-kind acceptance evidence mis-aims the caller and can leave DeliveryEvidence (#3041, out of scope) entangled with acceptance `kind: merge`.
Disposition: State that finalize already drives complete, and that the missing production merge-kind stamp belongs on that acceptance complete / stamp path after persist/bind — not as a rewrite of delivery-evidence ancestry.

## Over-accept, inference, and pointer coherence are three mechanisms
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Same pin file — (1) `isEvidenceKindSuitable` returns true when `requiredAxes.length === 0` for every kind including `merge` and `test`; (2) `stampDeclaredTestEvidence` / `stampMatchAnyFileEvidence` use inference only as a negative skip (`strict-axis`) then stamp `kind: "test"` — they never choose `merge` from keywords; (3) `parseEvidence` calls `uatPointerShapeError` only when `kindRaw === "uat"`; other kinds accept any non-empty pointer. `pr-closeout-attestable/evaluate.ts` still tells authors `recorded_by accepts any non-empty string`.
Failure mode: Collapsing those into "keyword inference / isEvidenceKindSuitable still over-accepts or mis-stamps" lets a lean fix only empty-axis suitability and still ship incoherent `kind: test` → `.md` pointers, or fix only pointer shape and still leave empty-axis merge over-accept.
Disposition: Keep P1–P3, but name three controls in the lean: positive merge declaration, empty-axis over-accept at the gate, and stamp-time kind-versus-pointer coherence for human and agent authors alike. Do not credit inference with a stamp it does not perform.

## Road not taken

Steelmanned alternative: treat empty-axis + verified delivery-tip ancestry as sufficient to auto-stamp `kind: merge` without an explicit declaration. Rejected because the same empty-axis path accepts behavioural titles such as "Works for solo and external contributions." under `isEvidenceKindSuitable("merge", [])`, which is the honesty failure the target names. What would flip that verdict: a deterministic positive predicate that a criterion is merge-established without author declaration — none exists at this SHA, and prior #3791 critics already closed keyword inference as that predicate.

## Injection / swarm lens

The target changes what shared post-merge complete may attest about acceptance criteria (authority over plan item evidence, concurrency with finalize/complete writers). Existing controls to compose: `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate`, `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems`, `verifyDeliveryAncestry` / delivery-evidence for the pointer half, `uatPointerShapeError` as the coherence precedent, and the test-only fence on `skipAcceptanceEvidenceGate`. No new swarm mesh or prompt-ingest surface is required for the declaration + stamp sibling themselves.

Disposition: P2 coverage holds under the sharpened inventory; prefer the complete-path caller when choosing, because that is the clause-keyed walk the pain and issue sketch name.

## P3 pointer-coherence half maps to Bound item 4
footnote
Evidence: Pin `parseEvidence` calls `uatPointerShapeError` only when `kindRaw === "uat"`; other kinds accept any non-empty pointer. Bound item 4 extends that coherence to human and agent stamps alike and keeps `recorded_by` non-authoritative.
Failure mode: None for this half of P3; over-accept honesty is the separate suitability-dual finding above.
Disposition: Item 4 covers the coherence conjunct; item 3 plus the dual covers over-accept / remaining-work.

metadata.issueBody:
**Summary**

#3791 part two asked `finalizeCohort` to stamp merge-kind acceptance evidence for "criteria a merge genuinely establishes." All three round-1 critics on #3791 found no honest way to decide that set, so this is split out from #3791 as its own issue. The narrower version the critics converged on is below.

**Why the original framing does not bind**

- `isEvidenceKindSuitable` returns true for any kind when `inferRequiredStrictAxes` finds no axis. The strict-axis filter is a negative filter, not positive evidence that a merge proves a criterion (critics 5732002909, 5732007507).
- Run against #3791's own eight acceptance bullets, five infer no axis and would accept `kind: merge`, including behavioural claims such as "Works for solo and external contributions." Two cannot be satisfied at all: one infers all four strict axes, and one infers `uat` from the proper noun "UAT Tester 6" (critic 5732051162).
- `recorded_by` is not a control: `pr-closeout-attestable/evaluate.ts` already tells authors it accepts any non-empty string (critic 5732051162).
- Comment 5433984468 on #3791 showed the failure in practice: real pointers, wrong kinds (`kind: test` on `.md` files).

**Proposed direction**

1. Add `merge` as an explicitly declarable requirement (`requires` / `requiredEvidenceKind` / `acceptanceAxis`). Today these accept only `STRICT_ACCEPTANCE_AXES`.
2. Add a merge-kind sibling to `stampDeclaredTestEvidence` (#4732). It stamps only criteria that explicitly declare `merge`. The pointer must resolve to a commit that is an ancestor of the refreshed delivery tip (same shape as `verifyDeliveryAncestry`).
3. Give both writers a production caller. `stampDeclaredTestEvidence` has none today. The stamp runs after persist/bind on the same clause-keyed walk, so `clause:N` rows added by `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems` are not missed.
4. Criteria that are inferred-only or undeclared stay unattested, and the run fails visibly, naming each one.
5. Kind-versus-pointer coherence at stamp time for human and agent stamps alike, extending what `uatPointerShapeError` does for `uat` (comment 5433984468). For example, `kind: test` cannot point at a non-test artifact.

**Acceptance sketch**

- A criterion can declare `merge` explicitly, and schema plus gate tests cover it
- Merge-kind stamps are written only for criteria that declare it, with a pointer verified as an ancestor of the delivery tip
- Inferred-only criteria are never auto-stamped and are reported as remaining work
- `stampDeclaredTestEvidence` and the merge-kind sibling have a production caller
- Stamp-time kind-versus-pointer checks refuse incoherent stamps from any author
- `skipAcceptanceEvidenceGate` stays without a production caller
- CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry

**Out of scope**

- The post-merge lifecycle move itself (#3791, and the shipped #4937, #4864 and #4919 work)
- The pre-merge attestable gate (#3781, shipped)
- Changing the delivery-evidence requirement (#3041)

**Provenance**

Split out of #3791 part two per the round-1 critics above. The code references are from the critics' pin-reads at cb4c743 and are not re-verified against the current tip.

Refs #3791, #3781, #3240, #3156, #4732, #4563, #3041.
